## Parental OpControl 0.17.30

- New **Play with Luna** row with two categories: **Space Boards** and **LunarCraft**. Space Boards lists Moon Tower (playable) plus Orbit and Crater Clash (coming soon). LunarCraft lists Critter Lab, Critter Arena and Lunar Harvest (coming soon).
- **Moon Tower** is the first Space Board: build a shared tower 10 blocks wide and 6 levels high so every level adds up to 10. Each block's length is its number, levels that add up to 10 score +10, and landing on the same symbol scores +2. Power blocks (Rocket, Meteor, Eclipse, Double Star), a Swap button, Easy / Medium / Hard Luna opponents, and a Make 20 mode are included.
- Opening a game animates the Luna window to a large centred window over 90% of the monitor work area and back again; Escape asks before leaving. Unfinished games are saved on the device and offered as "Continue your game?" next time.
- The Luna panel inside a game gives short ready-made tips in English and Spanish, a Hint that asks a guiding question before showing the block length, and an optional Ask Luna box. Ask Luna uses the normal safety checks and the monthly token limit, not the daily chat limit.
- The per-child Luna AI tab has a **Games** switch (on by default) and a **Games this week** summary. Turning games off hides the Play with Luna row. Games count toward normal screen time only.
- Finished games send a small result record (game, mode, level, result, score, duration) to the server.
